subtitulo: Bulk-import products from an Excel file.
descripcion: Upload an .xlsx file. Recognizes both the simple format (codigo, nombre, categoria, subgrupo, precio_compra, precio_venta, stock_actual...) and a real internal inventory format (ITEM, ARTICULO, TIPO, MARCA, MODELO, N° SERIE, ESTADO, EXISTENCIA, VALOR UNITARIO, ESTANTE, NIVEL, DETALLE / COMPATIBILIDAD, ASIGNACION...), in any order and even with a title row before the headers. Only the code and name are required; if the code already exists, it will be updated.
